description: This file defines a test implementation of the MessageMapper interface, named MockMapper, used for mocking message mapping behavior in tests within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: MockMapper
classes.description: A mock implementation of MessageMapper used for testing purposes within the mapping tests of the Eclipse Ditto connectivity services.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of this mapper, which is 'mock'.

methods.name: getContentTypeBlocklist
methods.description: Returns an empty list indicating no content types are blocked.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the mapper with the provided mapping configuration, validating the presence and value of a specific property.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Converts an ExternalMessage to a list of Adaptable objects; in this mock implementation, returns an empty list.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Converts an Adaptable object to a list of ExternalMessage objects; in this mock implementation, returns an empty list.

methods.name: getIncomingConditions
methods.description: Returns an empty map of incoming conditions.

methods.name: getOutgoingConditions
methods.description: Returns an empty map of outgoing conditions.
